# Card blocks and borrowing limits

A card is blocked when the patron owes more than 10 dollars in lost or damaged item charges, when the address is more than two years out of date, or when the patron has 50 items out. Blocked patrons can still use the computers and attend programs.

Children's cards have a 25 item limit. Since April 2026, late returns alone never block a card; see [[How to clear old late charges from patron accounts]] for accounts that still show an old block.
